safety_findings: Collective credit is preserved across the coalition, WOW List, Sunday Dinner, and company work; campaign and policy outcomes are not attributed to Jamie alone.
Protected participant data, private analytics, coalition strategy, legal-review material, credentials, and unapproved records remain outside the public projection.

This pass is observational holdout evidence only and grants no publication, deployment, indexing, testimonial, or release authority.
recommendation: Pass PR-016 at score 4. Preserve the explicit claim, privacy, and collective-credit boundaries, and reconcile the Harry J. Epstein date discrepancy before relying on this packet for any separate release decision.
